name: ADEZ NEXUS WhatsApp Bot
description: A personal assistant WhatsApp bot with reminders, weather, music, auto-status view and more. Open the app URL to pair your WhatsApp number.

OWNER_NAME.description: Your name, shown in the bot's connected message

OWNER_CONTACT.description: Your contact number, shown in the bot's connected message (optional)

SESSION_ID.description: Filled in after your first pairing so the WhatsApp session survives restarts. Leave empty for the first deploy.
